newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan govt pledges support for NCB.
newsitem.headline: Japan govt pledges support for NCB.

text.p: Japan's chief government spokesman pledged support on Wednesday for troubled Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) which announced a restructuring on Tuesday.
Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference: "The government will cooperate with the Bank of Japan to help Nippon Credit Bank restructure itself."

Kajiyama said the government hoped the NCB restructuring and a merger announced on Tuesday by two banks in Hokkaido, northern Japan, "will make a great contribution to restoring trust in Japan's financial system".
Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd, Japan's 10th biggest commercial bank, and smaller regional bank Hokkaido Bank Ltd said they would merge in April next year.

NCB, the smallest of the nation's three long-term credit banks, separately announced on Tuesday that it will restructure, halting overseas operations, selling off its Tokyo headquarters and posting losses to dispose of problem loans.
